products.name: AGM X7 Pro Thermal Imaging Rugged Smartphone, 6 GB + 256 GB, 10,000 mAh, Android 16
specs: 6 GB RAM, 256 GB storage, microSD slot
products.warranty: 1-year limited warranty from delivery under AGM's store terms

products.summary: The lightest way to get a 256×192-class thermal sensor in a phone. Same thermal module and 10,000 mAh battery as the G3 Pro at $100 less, with Android 16 and eSIM, in a 375 g (13.2 oz) body.
products.fit: Electricians, HVAC techs, home inspectors and hunters who want a thermal screening camera they can carry every day on T-Mobile or AT&T.
caveats: AGM markets 512×384; that is an upscaled output from a 256×192 sensor. Reviewers found temperature readings run a few degrees high, so treat it as a screening tool.

Unlocked import with no carrier certification: bands cover T-Mobile and AT&T but there is no LTE band 13 or 5G n71, so skip it for Verizon. Confirm VoLTE with your carrier by IMEI before porting a number.
Thermal use drains the battery quickly (androidpctv review), and the 6 GB RAM is modest for the price.
Free AGM Buds 8 bundle shown on AGM's site 2026-11-06; bundles change.

products.summary: The X7 Pro's thermal module and battery with twice the RAM, four times the storage, 18 W wireless charging and a 1,000-lumen floodlight. TechRadar and Digital Camera World named it the best rugged phone for thermal imaging.
products.fit: Field workers who store a lot of thermal video and want the floodlight and faster wireless charging; the X7 Pro is the better value if you only need the thermal camera.
caveats: Same 256×192 sensor as the X7 Pro behind the 512×384 marketing figure; readings ran a few degrees above an IR thermometer in Notebookcheck's test.
Notebookcheck measured the speaker at 92.6 dB, well under the 116 dB claim, and found no eSIM and single-band GNSS.
AGM sells some models in a US T-Mobile-only version; confirm which version you are ordering and check band 13 is absent before buying for Verizon.
AGM's site showed a 10% off plus free earbuds banner for the G3 Pro on 2026-11-06; the discount is applied by AGM, not a code.

notes: Query choice: 'best phone with thermal camera' and its variants return vendor blogs (Oukitel, Thermal Master), SEO listicles and spec databases; no page compares native sensor resolution, weight and US carrier fit. Reddit was unreachable (reddit.com blocked, two mirrors down), so complaint counts come from the EEVblog thread (30+ posts), GSMArena comment pages, desertcart/retailer owner reviews and six professional reviews. Pain-point counts: inflated or unclear thermal resolution 9; carrier/Verizon compatibility 6; readings a few degrees off with no calibration 4; weight 6; thermal app battery drain 3; few or no software updates 5; awkward report export 2. Segments and winners: (1) daily-carry thermal for trades and inspection: AGM X7 Pro, 256×192 native (highest in any phone), 375 g, $599, Android 16; (2) carrier-sold or FirstNet: Sonim XP Pro Thermal, $649.99 at AT&T today, Lepton 3.5 160×120, 267 g; (3) max battery/brightness: Ulefone Armor 29 Pro Thermal $799.99 today, 688 g, same 256×192 native per Ulefone's own GSMArena reply about the identical ThermoVue T2 module; (4) cheapest FLIR: Blackview XPLORE 1 Pro $359 today on store.blackview.hk, 640 g. Thermal resolution evidence: GSMchoice and iElectro spec tables list the X7 Pro sensor as 256×192 at 12 µm; AndroidGuys and Digital Camera World call the G3 Pro's 512×384 interpolated; Gizmochina gives 12 µm / 3.2 mm, consistent with a 256×192 core. Verification: AGM prices and availability (X7 Pro $599, G3 Pro $699, X7 $399, all in stock) read today via the store's search endpoint; the store's product endpoint and product pages returned HTTP 429 all session (also for Ulefone and Blackview product reads), so variant/version options and the AGM US policy page text could not be read today. Warranty (1 year) is from AGM's own blog and the en-ch policy page snippet; returns (15 days, defects only) from AGM's EU/CA refund pages read today; the EU terms page states 2 years, which is EU statutory, so I used 1 year for the US store. G3 Pro: two extra store handles at $629.10 and $643.08 (10%-off listings tied to the site banner) exist but could not be opened; record uses the canonical $699 listing. Not verified and kept off the page: AGM X7 Pro VoLTE certification on any US carrier; whether the AGM 'US T-Mobile only' variant wording applies to the X7 Pro (directly read only for the H6 Pro); Blackview US shipping terms; Doogee Fire 6 Max native thermal resolution. Amazon: amzcheck returned blocked/empty for every query, so no Amazon price comparison was possible; the AGM store is the only verified route. Codes: no Awin codes supplied; two site codes found apply to products not recorded (PAD P3, Note N2).
